title: SmacksUtils
description: This Mod implements some simple QoL improvements i enjoy playing with and i will add features as i have time and ideas.
body:
This Mod implements some simple QoL improvements i enjoy playing with and i will add features as i have time and ideas.

 

Currently this mod implements Backpacks, Veinminer, Item/Xp Magnet, Light Wand, Enchanting Tool, Teleportation Tablet, fast block placement, fast eating. Many things can be configured using the "Mods" button added by the mod "Mod Menu".
